description.narrative: Maritime transport, including the operation of ships, ports and trucks is a significant source of GHG and other pollutants. Around 90% of traded goods are carried by sea and 60% of these passes through the ports of Asia. The project aims to assist South East Asian countries to transform their maritime transport sector to a low-carbon future in line with national and regional GHG priorities and international commitments, including the Initial IMO GHG Strategy and the UN SDGs. Actions towards this include capacity building, support in developing strategies, national action plans and demonstrating technology solutions for reducing GHG emissions from ships, within ports, and from hinterland transport. Enhanced capacities and regional knowledge network of international organisations, private sector, banks and maritime stakeholders ensure sustainability of the measures and support further decarbonization and necessary investment in greening the maritime sector in South East Asia.
